findings.detail: X02 includes unfunded or fee-only credit commitment rows for which the filing explicitly reports the rate as N/A and shows no principal.

rationale: The source schedule explicitly reports N/A for the rate terms and leaves Interest Rate blank on the cited flagged credit rows; each also has no principal and only negative amortized-cost/fair-value amounts consistent with an unfunded or fee-only commitment. A nearby funded Charlie RF Voltron term loan in table 10 row 8 instead reports SOFR + 5.00% and 8.67%, confirming that the schedule populates rates when applicable. The stored blank therefore agrees with raw source, and X02 is firing outside its proper scope.
